reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first analytical pass. Began again from adopted Appendix 1d, the current September-2026 course tables, the actual thesis and moot-court entries and the inspected legal course descriptions, then reconsidered the completed UCR contributions and comparisons against the active workbook and finished audience fields. This is not independent human review or live rendering.
findings: Confirmed the exact generic Dutch Law target and LLB qualification from the adopted appendix, overriding the recruitment table’s BSc abbreviation. The separate Corporate Law specialisation is not selected. Ten six-credit courses in each earlier year and the final forty-two required credits plus eighteen minor credits total 180 uniquely. The four-credit Law/Society and eight-credit thesis are not silently normalised to six.

The eighteen-credit minor space is genuinely open to approved named, outside or custom minors. The named practice and sustainable-future minors support related priorities, but neither is imposed on the comparator. Their three modules are not counted with a parent eighteen-credit block. The exchange alternative requires separate Examination Board substitution; its recruitment-page thirty credits are not simply added or swapped into the chosen forty-two-plus-eighteen pathway.

Adopted Article 33 requires ninety EC for Moot Court at registration and ninety EC for the thesis when teaching starts. The dated entries confirm the distinction and the thesis’s autumn entry and year-long duration. Footnote 9 specifically requires a completed Tilburg Skills Lab for entrants from September 2025, including this cohort. Completing the first two years plus the non-credit Skills Lab satisfies all conditions. Earlier constitutional/private/criminal/procedural foundations precede their deepening courses. Non-credit language/development requirements are retained outside credit totals.

The current thesis describes general academic legal inquiry using an appropriate framework and method, so the recruitment page’s stray company-law topic wording is not used to narrow this generic target. The mandatory moot court includes legal-source research, procedural documents and oral pleading. Legal Philosophy B concerns the EU’s legal/political union, representation and legitimacy; Law/Society combines technology, legal economics and legal psychology. These contents were reconsidered rather than treating inherited rationales about differently named curricula as evidence.

The closest UCR response now includes substantive transnational business law alongside the legal gateway and comparative/private/criminal/constitutional/rights/EU/international study. Required business foundations supply concrete enterprise context. The sustainability option strengthens commercial/legal, policy and economic content in place of weak farming, geology, generic data and unspecified partner-project claims. Its sustainability science and communication are complements to legal governance, not environmental-law doctrine. The practice option retains real legal/arbitration work, negotiation and rhetorical communication, replacing primary-school rhetorical teaching with bounded AI-governance study.

All forty-seven target interests were reconciled. Judicial-decision-writing and virtual-courtroom examples are not asserted beyond currently evidenced legal reasoning, procedural writing and oral practice. Career examples confer no legal-professional entitlement. Every selected course contribution was assessed anew from its available profile or description, including description-only public-policy analysis. Three coherent priorities pass numerical and qualitative distinctness: sixty-seven-and-a-half, thirty-seven-and-a-half and sixty EC each way.

Twelve partial relationships identify important legal subjects or disciplinary methods. Criminal liability is matched to the substantive liability course, rather than claiming full criminal procedure. Private Law is placed with the broad private-law introduction rather than repeated across three specialist courses. Transnational arbitration is a bounded practical counterpart to Moot Court; negotiation corresponds only to the ADR part of civil procedure. Economics is not tax or labour law; business foundations are not company-formation law; constitutional/administrative content is not counted twice. The legal thesis remains unmatched with optional research separate from scheduled credits.

All seven original offering conflicts are repaired through feasible rescheduling or substantively motivated course changes. Legal/business foundations and research statistics precede their formal dependants. The three schedules each have twenty-four unique courses, four per term, first-year PPD and at least six advanced courses. Current offerings and prerequisites are verified directly; no old offering is restored and no extra hard sequencing rule is invented.

Read twenty-eight component titles, eight notes, three concepts, twelve partial relationships, sixteen unmatched reasons and thirty-six selected descriptions using the established renderer mapping. Source links, English title, audience references and optional research resolve correctly. Reused shared descriptions only at unchanged code/name/text versions; no shared academic issue reopened. No workbook, enrichment, app or renderer code changed; no local Shiny/browser or screenshot claim is made.
